name: Apply baseline correction
summary: Applies baseline correction to epoched MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python Epochs.apply_baseline over a tmin-tmax window and saves the corrected epochs.
description: For each channel and epoch, subtracts the mean signal over the baseline window [tmin, tmax] (seconds relative to the epoch time 0) using mne.Epochs.apply_baseline, and saves meg-epo.fif. Use it after epoching, before averaging or time-frequency analyses. tmin must be smaller than tmax and the window must lie within the epoch time range.

inputs.description: Epoched MEG/EEG data in MNE format (-epo.fif).

parameters.description: Start time for baseline correction application
End time for baseline correction application

citations.text: Hayashi S., Caron B. A., Heinsfeld A. S. et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).

failure_modes.message: Invalid baseline window: tmin must be less than tmax
